answer: Put keystroke plus content combined proof at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Faking 754 identities means 754 fresh proofs and 67106 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. What carries the juniper here is verification, the anchor of cost is what stops the farm, and the wharf of the record keeps every claim checkable. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
